# ReportPortal Documentation

> Get started with ReportPortal: real-time results, ML triage, and collaborative analysis to speed decisions and improve quality with a clear test report dashboard.

## Overview

- [What is ReportPortal?](https://reportportal.io/docs/): Get started with ReportPortal: real-time results, ML triage, and collaborative analysis to speed decisions and improve quality with a clear test report dashboard.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/): Discover ReportPortal basics - how to run tests, review results, use analytics, and navigate dashboards effectively.
- [Features](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/): Discover ReportPortal's features like real-time reporting, AI capabilities across the testing lifecycle, visualization of test data and more.
- [Tutorial](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/Tutorial/): ReportPortal guide. How to do test failure analysis, how to create dashboard to manage test results and use capabilities of continuous testing platform.
- [User role guides](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/UserRoleGuides/): Learn ReportPortal permissions by account type and role, then follow role-based guides for QA, admins, and TestOps workflows.
- [Unified test reporting](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/UnifiedTestReporting/): Unify automation, agentic, and manual test results in one place. Streamline collaboration, real-time insights, and quality gates from a single source of truth.
- [Categorisation of failures](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/CategorisationOfFailures/): Learn how ReportPortal streamlines defect triage with clear categories, root cause insights, and faster resolution across teams for more reliable testing outcomes.
- [AI capabilities](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/AICapabilities/): How ReportPortal uses ML, MCP, and agentic reporting together — from test design and execution to failure analysis and release decisions.
- [AI failure reason detection](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/AIFailureReasonDetection/): Use AI to auto-categorize failures, reduce manual triage, and speed bug discovery. ReportPortal automates test failure analytics for faster, accurate results.
- [Rich artifacts in test reports](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/RichArtifactsInTestReports/): Enrich your automation test report with logs, screenshots, videos, and network data. Simplify debugging, defect triage, and test failure analysis in one place.
- [Real-time reporting](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/RealTimeReporting/): Get live test results as executions run. Start triage early, shorten feedback loops, and improve release speed with a real-time test results dashboard.
- [Visualisation of test results](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/VisualisationOfTestResults/): Track key metrics with real-time widgets and charts. Visualize trends, failures, and ROI on a flexible test automation metrics dashboard for faster decisions.
- [Quality Gates](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/QualityGates/): Automate GO/NO-GO checks with Quality Gates in ReportPortal. Enforce standards, speed releases, and ensure reliability using aggregated test execution data.
- [REST API](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/RESTAPI/): Extend and integrate ReportPortal using a powerful REST API to push results, fetch analytics, and build custom reports and dashboards across your tooling.
- [SCIM Server feature](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/SCIMServerFeature/): Automate user provisioning and access with SCIM in ReportPortal. Sync roles and projects from your IdP to simplify identity management and improve security.
- [Test Executions](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/TestExecutions/): View all test executions in one place with powerful filters and a customizable layout for faster analysis and easier troubleshooting.
- [Organizations](https://reportportal.io/docs/getting-started/features/Organizations/): Structure projects in ReportPortal using a two-level hierarchy, centralized settings, and scalable test management.

## Installation & Deployment

- [Installation & Deployment](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/): Explore step-by-step instructions for deploying ReportPortal, a powerful, centralized test automation tool.
- [Advanced Installation](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/): Explore advanced installation capabilities to optimize your test automation dashboard.
- [Installation Steps](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/installation-steps/): Explore step-by-step instructions for deploying ReportPortal, a powerful, centralized test automation tool.
- [Upgrade & Migration](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/upgrade-and-migration/): Upgrade and migrate our test automation reporting dashboard safely with guidance on backups, data transfer, and system updates.
- [File storage options](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/file-storage-options/): Configure file storage options for ReportPortal including filesystem, MinIO, and cloud storage solutions.
- [Hardware Requirements](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/HardwareRequirements/): Boost performance with expert-backed configuration tips for your test automation dashboard.
- [Components Overview](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/ComponentsOverview/): ReportPortal Components Overview page explains each service - Gateway, API, UAT, Analyzer, Migrations, Index, UI - to help you configure and scale your system effectively.
- [Basic monitoring configuration](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/BasicMonitoringConfiguration/): Configure basic monitoring in ReportPortal to track server health, database performance, and resource usage with Telegraf, InfluxDB, and Grafana.
- [Deploy with Docker](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/installation-steps/DeployWithDocker/): Make your test automation reporting more portable. Reduce the risk of configuration issues with your test reporting tool using Docker.
- [Jobs configuration](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/JobsConfiguration/): Configure ReportPortal jobs for automated data retention and cleanup to keep your system running efficiently and organized.
- [Deploy without Docker](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/installation-steps/DeployWithoutDocker/): Deploy ReportPortal without Docker for traditional server installations and custom test automation reporting tools configurations.
- [Deploy with Kubernetes](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/installation-steps/DeployWithKubernetes/): Deploy ReportPortal on Kubernetes using Helm to streamline test reporting and analysis with scalable, containerized infrastructure.
- [Maintain commands Cheat sheet](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/MaintainCommandsCheatSheet/): Quickly manage and troubleshoot your ReportPortal instance with essential Docker commands for installation, backup, cleanup, and service monitoring.
- [Additional configuration parameters](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/AdditionalConfigurationParameters/): Optimize ReportPortal setup with customizable parameters - ports, session timeouts, database and API settings via Docker-friendly environment variables.
- [Deploy via Google Cloud Marketplace](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/installation-steps/DeployViaGoogleCloudMarketplace/): Deploy ReportPortal quickly via Google Cloud Marketplace with one-click installation for scalable test automation reporting tools.
- [Deploy with Minikube](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/installation-steps/DeployWithMinikube/): Deploy ReportPortal on Minikube for local Kubernetes testing and development.
- [Setup TLS / HTTPS Docker Compose + Traefik v2](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/SetupTLSHTTPSDockerComposeTraefikV2/): Practical guide to setting up TLS/HTTPS in our test results dashboard
- [Docker Hardened Images support for Helm Chart](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/DockerHardenedImagesSupportForHelmChart/): Docker Hardened Images for ReportPortal Helm. Configure PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ with DHI registry, security contexts, and Helm values.
- [AWS Load Balancer Integration on EKS](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/AWSLoadBalancerIntegrationOnEKS/): Configure ReportPortal audit logging and collect logs with Fluent Bit sidecars, shared volumes, and Helm values.
- [Audit logs and log collection](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/AuditLogsAndLogCollection/): Configure ReportPortal audit logging and collect logs with Fluent Bit sidecars, shared volumes, and Helm values.
- [Migrate one instance to another](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/MigrateOneInstanceToAnother/): Efficiently migrate your ReportPortal instance to AWS by backing up and restoring PostgreSQL, MinIO, and OpenSearch data, ensuring seamless continuity.
- [Migrate one instance to another](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/upgrade-and-migration/MigrateOneInstanceToAnother/): Efficiently migrate your ReportPortal instance to AWS by backing up and restoring PostgreSQL, MinIO, and OpenSearch data, ensuring seamless continuity.
- [Scaling ReportPortal services](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/ScalingReportPortalServices/): Learn how to dynamically scale ReportPortal services using Docker or Kubernetes, ensuring optimal performance and reliability for your testing infrastructure.
- [Deploy with AWS ECS Fargate](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/DeployWithAWSECSFargate/): Deploy ReportPortal on AWS ECS Fargate for scalable test automation reporting with serverless container management.
- [Quick Start Guide for Google Cloud Platform GKE](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/QuickStartWithGCPGKE/): Deploy ReportPortal on Google Cloud Platform GKE for scalable test automation reporting tools with Kubernetes orchestration.
- [Deploy on Ubuntu OS](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/installation-steps/DeployOnUbuntuOS/): Deploy ReportPortal on Ubuntu with Docker and Docker Compose. Follow step-by-step instructions to launch your test reporting environment efficiently.
- [Upgrading PostgreSQL for ReportPortal v24.2 and later](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/UpgradingPostgreSQLForReportPortalV24.2AndLater/): Upgrade PostgreSQL database for ReportPortal v24.2 and later versions with data preservation.
- [Amazon Application Load Balancer Configuration Guide](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/AmazonALBNGINXIngressController/): Configure Amazon ALB and NGINX Ingress Controller for ReportPortal test automation reporting tools on AWS EKS.
- [Upgrading PostgreSQL for ReportPortal v24.2 and later](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/upgrade-and-migration/UpgradingPostgreSQLForReportPortalV24.2AndLater/): Upgrade PostgreSQL database for ReportPortal v24.2 and later versions with data preservation.
- [S3 Cloud Storage](https://reportportal.io/docs/installation-and-deployment/advanced-installation/file-storage-options/S3CloudStorage/): Configure S3 cloud storage for the ReportPortal Flaky Test Detection tool using AWS, MinIO, or other S3-compatible providers.

## Configuration

- [Configuration](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/): Understand multi-level configuration in ReportPortal for better control over system, organizations, and project settings.
- [Instance level](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/instance-level/): Configure ReportPortal at the instance level. Manage organizations, users, server settings, and plugins for the whole test reporting platform.
- [Organization level](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/organization-level/): Configure organization-level settings in ReportPortal. Manage projects, users, roles, and data retention for test reporting across the organization.
- [Project level](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/project-level/): Configure project-level settings in ReportPortal. Manage the project team, notifications, defect types, analyzer, and how long test results are stored.
- [User account](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/user-account/): Manage your ReportPortal user account for an efficient real time dashboard open source.
- [All Organizations](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/instance-level/AllOrganizations/): View and manage all organizations on the instance. Search, filter, export, create, rename, and delete organizations in ReportPortal.
- [Edit personal information](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/user-account/EditPersonalInformation/): Manage your personal profile information, preferences, and account settings in ReportPortal.
- [Organizations plugin](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/organization-level/OrganizationsPlugin/): Organize multiple projects in your test execution dashboard under a single structure with the Organizations plugin.
- [Project Team](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/project-level/ProjectTeam/): Manage the project team in ReportPortal. Invite or assign users, change project roles, and unassign members from the project.
- [All Users](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/instance-level/AllUsers/): Manage all users on the ReportPortal instance. Invite or create users, assign roles, grant admin rights, and export user lists.
- [Project Settings](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/project-level/ProjectSettings/): Configure project settings, notifications, defect types, and data retention policies to optimize your test automation reporting dashboard performance.
- [Projects](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/organization-level/Projects/): Create, rename, and delete projects, invite users, and quickly assign or unassign yourself—all from one Projects page.
- [Restore a password](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/user-account/RestoreAPassword/): Reset your ReportPortal password securely using email verification to regain access to your account.
- [Delete account](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/user-account/DeleteAccount/): Delete your ReportPortal account and personal data securely with proper data retention policies.
- [Organization Users](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/organization-level/OrganizationUsers/): Manage organization users - invite or assign users, set roles, control project access, and unassign members—all from one centralized page.
- [Server Settings](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/instance-level/ServerSettings/): Configure server settings including GitHub authorization, SSO login, and Google Analytics in ReportPortal test automation reporting tools.
- [Data retention procedure](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/user-account/DataRetentionProcedure/): Configure data retention periods for PII data in ReportPortal. Set individual retention durations and manage data lifecycle using test execution reporting.
- [Instance Plugins](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/instance-level/Plugins/): Integrate ReportPortal with bug tracking, notifications, authorization, and import plugins to streamline QA workflows.
- [Organization Settings](https://reportportal.io/docs/configuration/organization-level/OrganizationSettings/): Set organization-level retention for launches, logs, and attachments. These limits apply to all projects in the organization.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/): Integrate ReportPortal with test frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and plugins to automate test reporting and connect your testing tools.
- [Test Framework Integration](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-frameworks/): Integrate your test framework with ReportPortal. Configure agents, send results, and enrich logs, attachments, and attributes for a clear automation test report.
- [AI agents](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/ai-agents/): AI MCP Server enables automated test analysis, defect triage and QA insights by connecting AI tools directly to ReportPortal without UI.
- [Authorization](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/authorization/): Set up secure logins with Active Directory, GitHub, LDAP, and SAML. Manage authentication to keep ReportPortal access safe and simple for every role.
- [Bug tracking](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/bug-tracking/): Integrate Jira, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Monday, and Rally to link, post, and sync issues from ReportPortal for faster defect triage and clearer ownership.
- [Import](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/import/): Import JUnit and RobotFramework results to centralize analysis in ReportPortal. Simplify reporting, reduce manual work, and keep your automation test report current.
- [Infrastructure providers](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/infrastructure-providers/): Enrich ReportPortal test results via infrastructure providers like Sauce Labs with videos, logs and full execution environment context.
- [Integration with CI/CD](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/cicd/): Connect ReportPortal with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and more to automate quality checks and surface insights in your test execution dashboard.
- [Notifications](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/notifications/): Configure notification plugins for Email, Slack, and Telegram in ReportPortal for real-time alerts.
- [Test platforms](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-platforms/): Automatically send test executions from test platforms to our test automation results dashboard.
- [User Provisioning](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/UserProvisioning/): Set up JIT and SCIM user provisioning to automate account creation, updates, and roles in ReportPortal for secure, scalable access management.
- [Java](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-frameworks/Java/): Enhance your test automation with advanced Java reporting in ReportPortal.
- [JavaScript](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-frameworks/JavaScript/): ReportPortal integrates with JavaScript frameworks, enabling better test management with a real-time test results dashboard.
- [.Net](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-frameworks/Net/): Use .NET frameworks with ReportPortal for real-time test monitoring, trend tracking, failure management, result analysis, and test automation reports.
- [Python](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-frameworks/Python/): Use Python test frameworks with automation testing reporting tools to centralize results, analyze failures, and improve test management and QA processes.
- [PHP](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-frameworks/PHP/): ReportPortal integrates with popular PHP frameworks, helping teams manage test results, visualize trends, and optimize testing efficiently.
- [Other](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/test-frameworks/Other/): Integrate unsupported or custom test frameworks by implementing your own integration with ReportPortal, enabling centralized test result visualization.
- [SAML Providers](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/authorization/SamlProviders/): Use SAML SSO with Azure or Okta to securely access your test automation metrics dashboard and simplify user login.
- [System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM)](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/UserProvisioning/Scim/): Use SCIM in ReportPortal to auto-provision users and groups from Okta or Azure, keeping roles, access, and attributes always up to date and secure.
- [Implement own integration](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/ImplementOwnIntegration/): Learn how to implement custom integration with ReportPortal using the developer guide.
- [Manage plugins](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/ManagePlugins/): Install, configure, and manage plugins to extend ReportPortal functionality for enhanced test execution reporting capabilities.
- [Email Server](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/notifications/EmailServer/): Configure email server settings for automated notifications in ReportPortal.
- [MCP Server](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/ai-agents/MCPServer/): Automate test analysis with MCP Server, use AI to detect issues, summarize results, and streamline QA workflows for faster, smarter decision-making.

- [Mobitru](https://reportportal.io/docs/integrations/infrastructure-providers/Mobitru/): Integrate Mobitru with ReportPortal to automatically load session recordings and view test execution videos directly in your test results.

- [Pattern Analysis](https://reportportal.io/docs/analysis/PatternAnalysis/): Define string or regex rules to detect known error patterns. Speed up investigations and track frequent causes with the Most Popular Pattern widget.
- [Immediate Pattern Analysis](https://reportportal.io/docs/analysis/ImmediatePatternAnalysis/): Start Pattern Analysis before a launch ends to catch issues early. Trigger via attributes and speed defect triage on large runs in ReportPortal.
- [Unique Error Analysis](https://reportportal.io/docs/analysis/UniqueErrorAnalysis/): Group identical errors to speed triage. See unique failures, match tests by error, and apply ML suggestions for faster, clearer test failure analysis.
- [AI Analysis](https://reportportal.io/docs/analysis/AIAnalysis/): AI-powered MCP Server enables smart test analysis, automated defect triage, and unified QA insights without manual interaction.
- [Quality Gates plugin](https://reportportal.io/docs/analysis/quality-gates/QualityGatesPlugin/): A complete guide to the ReportPortal Quality Gates plugin - upload, disable, and uninstall steps.

- [Email Notification Issues](https://reportportal.io/docs/administration-and-maintenance/issues-troubleshooting/EmailNotificationIssues/): Troubleshoot email notification issues in ReportPortal QA metric dashboard with ThreadPool and SMTP configuration solutions.
